question: Five-legged creatures have damaged which 1250 mile long wonder of the world?
references: Great Barrier Reef World Heritage Area
greedy_answer: The Great Barrier Reef is a 1250 mile long wonder of the world. It has been damaged by five-legged creatures, specifically the Crown-of-Thorns Starfish (also known as the Crown-of-Thorns Sea Star), which is a coral-eating predator.
